critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1932 — path traversal guard uses normpath+startswith which is correct, but ALSO calls fetch_upload with the raw upload_path (not the normalized one). If /api/uploads/rooms/../../foo passes the local check somehow (it won't due to startswith), the cloud fetch still uses upload_path with '..' which is passed to Emergent object storage — mitigation: normalize upload_path before passing to fetch_upload. Currently benign because requests/routing normalizes.

server.py:1929 — no auth on GET /api/uploads/{path}. This is intentional for public-facing URLs (booking widget photos), but private uploads (guest IDs at /uploads/ids/) are also served unauthenticated. Consider auth gate for sensitive subpaths.

object_storage.py:57 — put_object failure is logged as warning but not re-raised. The upload endpoint then returns 'status: uploaded' even though the file is neither on disk nor in cloud — the subsequent GET will return 404. Consider raising to caller so client knows upload failed.
sentiment_pricing.py:126 — 'in last 90 days' filter uses string comparison on review_date (isoformat). Works for ISO 8601 but fragile if any legacy records store date differently. OK for now.

sentiment_pricing.py:142 — JSON parsing after `.strip('```json').strip('```')` uses str.strip which removes any of those chars from ends, not a literal prefix strip. e.g. 'json{...}' would also strip 'j','s','o','n'. Prefer `re.sub(r'^```(?:json)?\n?|```$', '', reply)`. Currently works because gpt-5.2 usually returns clean JSON.

booking_widget.py:455 — save_upload path derived via `filepath.split('/uploads/')[1]` — depends on ROOM_UPLOAD_DIR containing '/uploads/'. If admin ever changes UPLOAD_DIR to '/data/photos', this silently produces wrong subpath. Prefer passing subpath directly.
MobileApprovalsPanel.js:16 — soundOn initial state reads localStorage on every mount; SSR/hydration safe here (CRA), but note the useState initializer runs once. OK.

MobileApprovalsPanel.js chime uses AudioContext without user gesture on background polls (line 47) — browsers may block without prior interaction. Since first play is triggered by toggle button (user gesture), context is unlocked before polls fire — OK design.
